method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Trump teased an Iran deal that didn't come, but markets soared. Here’s why it keeps happening
Equities.summary: As oil reserves and munitions stockpiles reportedly dwindle, analysts wonder how much longer markets will pounce when the Trump admin. dangles an Iran deal.
Equities.reason: Geopolitical de‑escalation (even teased) removes an oil/geopolitical risk premium and supports risk‑on flows; relevant to broad equity sentiment but not a fundamental shift, so moderate relevance.

Equities.title: U.S. economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July
Equities.summary: Nonfarm payrolls were projected to increase by 83,000 in July while the unemployment rate would hold steady at 4.2%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.
Equities.reason: Soft jobs print materially eases near‑term Fed tightening fears, a clear macro catalyst driving S&P record closes and broad risk rally — high relevance to the market regime.

Equities.title: Wall Street Risk Complex Surges Anew Amid Deluge of Fresh Cash
Equities.reason: Describes large, persistent liquidity and risk appetite inflows across equities — reinforces a market‑wide risk‑on/AI leadership regime; high relevance for broad equities.

Equities.title: The unwind of Situational Awareness isn't the only reason the AI trade is back
Equities.summary: The hedge fund's forced selling was a clearing event, but earnings are sustaining the AI trade
Equities.reason: Explains renewed, earnings‑backed AI leadership and how de‑leveraging cleared the way for sustained flow into AI names — important sector/regime narrative for equities.

Equities.title: SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants as demand soars
Equities.summary: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.
Equities.reason: Large capex plan signals strong AI-driven memory demand; positive for semiconductor sector and supportive of related equity valuations, but sector‑specific rather than market‑wide.

Equities.title: AMD buys chip startup that hardwires AI models into its silicon
Equities.summary: Taalas' current chip runs a small version of Meta's Llama 3.1, though the company is working on chips for bigger and more advanced models.
Equities.reason: M&A that accelerates AI differentiation in silicon — supportive for semis and AI leadership narrative, but company‑level and lower broad‑market relevance.

Equities.title: Global equity funds draw inflows for 11th week as upbeat earnings lift sentiment
Equities.reason: Sustained fund inflows underline liquidity‑driven rally and confirm earnings‑led positive sentiment — meaningful for overall equity positioning and market breadth.

Rates.title: US Treasury yields drop on soft NFP, Hormuz hopes ease Fed risks
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields drop across the curve on Friday amid growing speculation that the Iran-Oman deal is about to be sealed, which has so far pushed energy prices lower, while investors also digest a weak Nonfarm Payrolls report in the US.
Rates.reason: Direct market report: yields fell across the curve after weak NFP and easing geopolitical risk — clear bond-friendly signal that reduces near-term Fed hike odds. High relevance for Rates.

Rates.title: NY Fed inflation expectations ease modestly in the short term
Rates.summary: The New York Fed Survey of Consumer Expectations shows that households’ inflation expectations decreased slightly over the short-term horizon and remained unchanged at the medium and longer-term horizons. One-year inflation expectations eased from 3.7% in June
Rates.reason: Lower short-term inflation expectations support lower term premia and reduce urgency for further Fed tightening — positive for bond prices/yields down.

Rates.title: VIEW Soft July jobs report fuels skepticism over possible Fed rate hike
Rates.reason: Reuters thematic take: weak July payrolls lowered markets' odds of a near-term Fed hike — material for rates traders and likely to drive Treasury demand (yields lower).

Rates.title: US economy unexpectedly sheds 23,000 jobs in July
Rates.summary: Lacklustre figure prompts traders to scale back bets on Fed rate rises
Rates.reason: Major outlet reporting an unexpected payroll decline that prompted traders to trim Fed hike bets — reinforces a bond-positive (yields down) regime shift.

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Impact of the Bank of Japan's Reductions in JGB Purchases on the JGB Markets
Rates.reason: BOJ research indicates reduced JGB purchases — less central-bank demand can push JGB yields higher and tighten global fixed-income liquidity; a meaningful counterforce to US-focused easing narrative.

Rates.title: The Fed Didn’t Raise Rates. The Bond Market Did.
Rates.reason: Analysis noting a bond selloff despite Fed inaction — represents a notable market-driven rise in yields and a shorter-term negative signal for bonds, but lower relevance versus the dominant jobs/inflation narrative.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve: Fed focus shifts to jobs – ABN AMRO
Rates.summary: ABN AMRO’s Chief Economist Nick Kounis highlights renewed US labour market weakness, with Nonfarm Payrolls falling and household employment data softening. He notes the unemployment rate declined as labour force participation dropped to multi-decade lows, sign
Rates.reason: Strategist note that Fed attention is shifting toward jobs data; weaker employment reduces immediate Fed tightening pressure — modestly supportive for bond yields to fall.

FX.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: US inflation takes center stage next week
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) fell below the 100.00 region after sinking through Friday's session. July Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) showed the US economy shedding 23K jobs against forecasts of an 80K gain, with June revised down to 20K, and Average Hourly Earnings slow
FX.reason: Macro FX piece: DXY breaking <100 and a downside NFP surprise is the dominant USD-weakness narrative ahead of US inflation; large cross‑market implications for dollar pairs.

FX.title: Mexican Peso hits five-month high on weak US jobs data
FX.summary: The Mexican Peso (MXN) capitalizes on a weaker US jobs report and soars versus the US Dollar (USD) on Friday as risk appetite improves and the Greenback gets battered on speculation that the Federal Reserve (Fed) might not raise rates in 2026.
FX.reason: EMFX reaction to USD selloff: weak US jobs pushes rate-hike odds lower and boosts MXN on risk-on flows and Fed expectations.

FX.title: South Korean Won: Intervention risks support KRW against US Dollar – DBS
FX.summary: Chang Wei Liang at DBS Group Research notes that KRW is currently the best performing Asian currency, supported by strong semiconductor demand and reported FX intervention coordination between Korea, the US and Japan.
FX.reason: Intervention/co‑ordination risk is a direct FX-native driver supporting KRW (i.e. dollar softening vs. KRW); central-bank action raises relevance beyond a routine move.

FX.title: Australian Dollar climbs near two-month highs as NFP turns negative
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair surged to its highest in nearly two months past 0.7070 earlier on Friday, following the release of the United States (US) Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report. The move owes nothing to Australia.
FX.reason: AUD strength is directly tied to USD weakness after the surprise NFP miss; clear USD transmission into AUD/USD moves.

FX.title: Yen Jumps 1% Against Dollar After US Jobs Data
FX.reason: Large JPY move vs USD following US jobs weakness; meaningful for global FX and potential intervention chatter — strong USD-weakness signal priced into yen.

FX.title: US stocks, bonds rally after soft jobs report; yen bounces back
FX.reason: Cross‑asset Reuters note: soft US jobs triggered dollar selloff, bond rally and yen bounce — broad market confirmation of USD weakness and risk repricing.

FX.title: Swiss Franc gains against US Dollar after surprise decline in US payrolls
FX.summary: USD/CHF edges lower on Friday, erasing most of the previous day’s gains as the US Dollar (USD) weakens following a downside surprise in the US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) report. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 0.8080, down 0.53% on the day.
FX.reason: CHF benefitted from USD weakness after NFP; notable but more localized safe‑haven/FX pair move compared with major crosses.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar advances as US labor market weakness pressures USD
FX.summary: NZD/USD trades around 0.5890 on Friday at the time of writing, up 0.36% on the day.
FX.reason: NZD rise is a direct transmission of USD softness after the payrolls miss; modest relevance versus larger majors and JPY/intervention stories.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah: Supportive domestic backdrop, capped gains – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s FX analysts, including Charlie Lay and Moses Lim, note that USD/IDR slipped slightly but stayed below the key 18,000 level as softer global Oil prices and stronger Indonesia Q2 GDP supported the Rupiah.
FX.reason: IDR gains are tied to softer USD and supportive domestic prints; relevant for regional FX flows but lower market‑wide impact.

FX.title: The US bares its financial weak spot
FX.summary: Yen intervention points to the squishy underbelly of American weakness
FX.reason: Analysis linking yen intervention chatter to US financial weakness reinforces the dominant USD‑softness/intervention narrative; broader implications for FX policy and flows.

Commodities.title: Gold heads for best week since January after disappointing NFP
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) extends its recovery on Friday as weaker-than-expected US payroll growth weighs on the US Dollar (USD) and US Treasury yields. At the time of writing, XAU/USD trades around $4,356 after hitting $4,371, its highest level since June 17.
Commodities.reason: Weaker US NFP -> lower Treasury yields and USD -> clear positive impulse for gold. Macro, market-moving catalyst with high relevance to the gold price.

Commodities.title: Gold bugs spend $180 million betting all's clear for metal as bond yields stall
Commodities.summary: Despite a 25% decline in gold from its high in January, proponents of the precious metal are storming into bullish call positions.
Commodities.reason: Options flows show renewed retail/institutional bullish positioning; supportive to near-term gold demand but more tactical than structural.

Commodities.title: Gold: Discretionary demand keeps bulls in control - TD Securities
Commodities.summary: TD Securities strategists Ryan McKay and Bart Melek highlight that strong discretionary and Asian buying is supporting Gold, even as CTA (Commodity Trading Advisors) positioning has plateaued.
Commodities.reason: Fundamental bid from discretionary and Asian physical demand reinforces the broader macro-driven gold rally; meaningful but more structural/flow-based than headline shock.

Commodities.title: Citadel Securities’ Rubner says it’s time to start buying gold again
Commodities.reason: Sell-side institutional 'buy' call adds to bullish narrative and may reinforce flows; supportive but single-source signal with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD clears 50-day SMA, eyes $65
Commodities.summary: Silver price surges nearly 3% as it clears the 50-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) at $62.13, and reclaims the $63.00 figure as it struggles to surpass key resistance seen at $63.28, the July 6 high.
Commodities.reason: Technical breakout and follow-through amid weaker USD/yields supports silver; this is primarily technical/price-action driven so relevance capped.

Commodities.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softe
Commodities.reason: Weaker Chinese crude imports are a tangible demand headwind for oil prices. Important for the crude market given China's size; reduces near-term price support.

Commodities.title: Hormuz deal hopes rise as talks progress – Reuters
Commodities.summary: A US official said on Friday that there is progress in Oman-Iran talks and that a deal could be signed soon, according to Reuters. Once the deal is announced, this would restore commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, and the US would lift the blockade.
Commodities.reason: Progress toward restoring Strait of Hormuz shipping would remove a significant geopolitical risk premium from oil; sizable negative impact on oil risk premium and prices.

Commodities.title: Iran's chief negotiator accuses Trump of 'theater diplomacy' with Hormuz traffic near standstill
Commodities.summary: The conflict is broadening across the region, with Gulf energy infrastructure and key shipping choke points under renewed threat.
Commodities.reason: Reports of conflict broadening and threats to Gulf energy infrastructure increase oil risk premium and can push prices higher; countervailing to deal progress but market-relevant.

Commodities.title: Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham breezes through Senate, heads to House
Commodities.summary: A measure to impose new sanctions on Russian oil purchasers easily cleared the Senate and heads to the House.
Commodities.reason: Potential new sanctions on Russian oil purchasers could tighten global oil supply or re-route flows, modestly supportive to prices while legislative outcome remains uncertain.

Commodities.title: Lower crude oil prices reduced U.S.-Canada energy trade value in 2025
Commodities.summary: The value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau. Energy trade value is the total value of energy imports and exports between two countries and is dri
Commodities.reason: Lower average crude prices in 2025 reduced trade value; indicative of weaker price environment over the period but lower immediacy for front-month commodity pricing.

Commodities.title: The U.S.-Canada natural gas and electricity trade value rose in 2025
Commodities.summary: Although the total value of energy trade between the United States and Canada fell by 11% in 2025 to an estimated $137 billion, according to data from the U.S. Census Bureau, the trade value of natural gas and electricity between the two countries increased sl
Commodities.reason: Increase in U.S.-Canada natural gas trade value points to firmer cross-border gas flows/demand; modestly supportive for natural gas market fundamentals.

Crypto.title: Crypto’s infrastructure era arrives, with AI agents poised to reshape demand
Crypto.summary: Crypto companies are trying to build a second growth engine by turning agents into the next wave of users.
Crypto.reason: Adoption narrative: AI-driven agent demand implies structural user growth and new utility for crypto rails — positive for long-term demand but not an immediate price shock, medium relevance.

Crypto.title: Crypto market maker Wintermute lands SEC approval to trade equities and ETF blocks
Crypto.reason: Institutional plumbing: US broker-dealer status signals deeper Wall Street integration and improved market structure/liquidity for crypto markets — significant positive for institutional flows and market maturation.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin whales load up on $1.2 billion in BTC as ETFs attract $750 million
Crypto.reason: Flows/demand: Large whale accumulation combined with sizable ETF inflows points to tangible buying pressure and continued institutional participation — meaningful near-term positive for BTC liquidity and price.

Crypto.title: U.S. Senate opens first stage of crypto Clarity Act voting to give bill a chance next month
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarity: Progress toward a major legislative framework is a large structural positive (reduces regulatory uncertainty, enables institutional adoption). High relevance for market regime.

Crypto.title: OKX's Rafique doubts Clarity Act will pass, warns optimism is already priced into bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Counter-regulatory signal: Market skepticism that the Clarity Act will pass tempers optimism; important as a caution but lower relevance versus legislative progress.

Crypto.title: Another Bitcoin infrastructure exploit hits, this time draining Lightning payment servers
Crypto.reason: Security/infrastructure shock: Repeated exploits against Bitcoin's off-chain/payment infrastructure materially raise protocol risk and user confidence issues — significant negative for short-to-medium term sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bybit sues North Korea and Lazarus Group over $1.5 billion hack, secures asset freeze
Crypto.reason: Enforcement/recovery: Legal action and asset freezes against major hacking groups supports custody and recovery prospects, a constructive signal for institutional counterparties and exchange risk management.

Crypto.title: U.S. widens Iran crypto crackdown with sanctions on two exchanges
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical / sanctions risk: Expanded sanctions and enforcement actions reduce on‑ramps in sanctioned jurisdictions and increase compliance costs for global platforms — negative for ecosystem accessibility and volumes.

Crypto.title: Coldcard fallout shows up onchain as 210,000 bitcoin leaves old wallets
Crypto.reason: On-chain movement risk: Large wallet migrations tied to hardware/security fallout create potential selling or custody-risk signals — meaningful near-term negative for supply dynamics.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
Crypto.reason: Protocol / fork risk: Confusion and technical risk around a forked coin can create holder losses and market uncertainty — negative but relatively niche technical relevance.

Crypto.title: How a five-second trick let traders drain millions from Polymarket
Crypto.reason: DeFi exploit: Execution/MEV-style exploit drained liquidity and funds, underlining smart-contract risk and hurting confidence in some DeFi primitives — negative with moderate relevance.
